about: Firefly paintings the CTO moved from the owner's old Adobe account on Oct 13, 2026, for the LOCATIONS session (docs/coordination/locations.md). Each file is the full-size Firefly output as JPEG. status: new-place (a place the game has no painting of), new-variant (a new time or weather for a place the game has; gamePlace names it), campus-variant (morning/night/rain/winter of a campus in art/campuses), capitol-variant (a capitol light the manifest lacks). Firefly cut the names short, so place is a best reading; check each image. Delete a file in the PR that imports it.
